--- attempt1/Dockerfile
+++ attempt2/Dockerfile
@@ -3,12 +3,12 @@
 RUN rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && printf '%s\n' 'deb [check-valid-until=no] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/20261106T000000Z trixie main' 'deb [check-valid-until=no] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian-security/20261106T000000Z trixie-security main' > /etc/apt/sources.list
 
 FROM snapshot AS builder
-RUN apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev python3 python3-pip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+RUN apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 --with-new-pkgs --no-remove upgrade -y && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev python3 python3-pip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 COPY landlock.c requirements.lock /build/
 RUN gcc -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror /build/landlock.c -o /build/confine && python3 -m pip --isolated install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes --no-deps --no-compile --no-cache-dir --target /build/vendor -r /build/requirements.lock
 
 FROM snapshot AS runtime
-RUN apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates texlive-xetex texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended python3 poppler-utils && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+RUN apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 --with-new-pkgs --no-remove upgrade -y && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates texlive-xetex texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended lmodern=2.005-1 python3 poppler-utils && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 COPY landlock.c supervisor.py inspect_pdf.py build-closure.py texmf.cnf requirements.lock /opt/latex/
 COPY --from=builder /build/confine /opt/latex/confine
 COPY --from=builder /build/vendor/ /opt/latex/
